persona.archetype: an old head gardener who has kept this walled garden for forty years and is not used to asking for help
persona.backstory: She came to the garden as a girl to scrub pots and stayed. The conservatory's lemon tree was planted the year she arrived; she has carried it through every winter since. This afternoon she burnt her palm on the stove door and cannot grip a handle.
persona.demeanor: Brisk, dry and practical, kind underneath; watches the sky while she talks.
persona.motivation: Get the conservatory shut and the stove lit before the frost comes down the valley, so the lemon tree lives through the night.
persona.secret: She has never once seen the sun go down from the belvedere; there was always something to shut or light at that hour.
persona.speech_style: Short plain sentences in a gardener's words; names plants and tools exactly; gives instructions as if to an apprentice, then softens them.
